Welcome to YCS Indianapolis! 837 Duelists have gathered here this weekend for another shot at a YCS victory. They’ve assembled a variety of Decks for the competition, and are all looking to shape the Dueling world. We’ve seen success from all sorts of Decks, including Psychics, Wind-Ups, Geargias, HEROs, and Dino Rabbit. Which new contenders will break through to the top this weekend?
This is the last YCS tournament before the power of

will empower monsters with evil and revolutionize the world of Dueling. Stay with the coverage to find out which Decks will rise to the top in these final days before the power of the Orichalcos strikes!
